title: Subjective temporal order is a product of interpretation

statements.text: The temporal order of subjective events is a product of the brain’s interpretational processes, not a direct reflection of the timing of the events that make up those processes. The objective timing of discriminatory states can be measured, but it does not fix the timing of subjective experience. Dennett and Kinsbourne apply this to color phi, the cutaneous rabbit and Libet’s timing results.
